lessons.title: Step 24: Scan One Number at a Time (1, 2, 5)
lessons.description: Scan 1, 2, and 5 in turn. Use the highlighted rows, columns, and boxes to find where each number fits.

lessons.description: Scan numbers 1 through 9 one at a time. Use highlighting and pencil marks to find each position.

lessons.title: Step 39: 9×9 Sudoku Challenge 1
lessons.description: Complete the full 9×9 Sudoku. Use pencil marks and number highlighting when helpful.

lessons.description: Use the two-position method and scan one number at a time to solve the full grid.

lessons.description: Complete the second graduation puzzle. You can check at any time; incorrect entries are marked in red.

step14.title: Step 17: What Is 6×6 Sudoku? (Type 1)
step14.instruction:
Sudoku has three rules:
1. Each column contains 1–6 without repeats.
2. Each row contains 1–6 without repeats.
3. Each 6-cell box contains 1–6 without repeats.
Solve the three target cells in order. Correct answers remain on the board.

messages.有些小字不是這一排缺少的數字。按「空」可清除目前格子，再重新記錄。: Some notes are not missing from this row. Press Clear to erase this cell and record them again.
messages.有些小字不是這一橫排缺少的數字。按「空」可清除目前格子，再重新記錄。: Some notes are not missing from this row. Press Clear to erase this cell and record them again.
messages.再想一想：先看橫排，再看直排，最後檢查所在的六宮格。答對後數字會保留。: Think again: check the row, then the column, and finally the 6-cell box. Correct answers stay on the board.
messages.再想一想：觀察目標格所在的橫排、直排與六宮格。答對後數字會保留。: Think again: check the target cell's row, column, and 6-cell box. Correct answers stay on the board.
messages.下一題開始！筆記模式已自動開啟，請在兩個空格各記下目前題目缺少的兩個數字。: Next puzzle! Notes have been turned on automatically. Record the two missing numbers in the two empty cells.
messages.三題全部答對！你已學會利用橫排、直排與六宮格的規則解題。: All three are correct! You have learned to solve puzzles using row, column, and box rules.
messages.請先開啟「筆記」，依照指定順序在四個目標格寫下小字筆記。: Turn on Notes and record pencil marks in the four target cells in the specified order.
messages.三題全部完成！你已學會一次檢查一個數字。: All three are complete! You have learned to scan one number at a time.
messages.前四步請先開啟「筆記」，寫入兩個候選小字。: For the first four steps, turn on Notes and enter two candidate marks.
messages.原本題目提供的數字不能修改，請選擇空格。: The given numbers cannot be changed. Select an empty cell.
messages.太好了！你已依序完成全部 21 步，成功解開這盤數獨！: Excellent! You completed all 21 steps and solved this Sudoku!
messages.已選取空格，請按下方數字填入。: An empty cell is selected. Choose a number below to fill it.
messages.筆記模式目前關閉，請先按「筆記」開啟。: Notes are off. Press Notes to turn them on first.
messages.答對了！你已完成利用筆記推測答案的練習。: Correct! You completed the exercise using pencil notes to infer the answer.
messages.請先直接點選上方 6×6 棋盤裡已存在的數字，系統才會反白該數字的橫排、直排與六: First select a number already on the 6×6 board. The system will highlight its row, column, and box. The number buttons below are only for answers or notes.
messages.請先點選你認為可以突破的空格，再選擇數字。: Select the empty cell you think is the breakthrough, then choose a number.
messages.按下方數字填入答案；需要時可開啟筆記。: Choose a number below to enter your answer. You can turn on Notes if needed.
messages.可以自行判斷要記筆記或直接填入答案。: You can decide whether to add notes or enter the answer directly.
messages.已選取目標格，請用下方數字記錄兩個候選小字。: Target cell selected. Use the numbers below to enter the two pencil-mark candidates.
messages.請先按「筆記」開啟筆記模式，再選取目標格。: Turn on Notes first, then select the target cell.
messages.這是第二類數獨，六宮格為 3 列 × 2 欄。可以先點棋盤上的數字觀察反白，或使: This is the second type of 6×6 Sudoku, with 3 rows × 2 columns per box. Select a number on the grid to see its highlights, or use Notes to record candidates. If you get stuck, review Step 21.
messages.先點選棋盤上的數字，觀察該數字所在的橫排、直排與六宮格；選取空格後按數字填入。筆: Select a number on the grid to highlight its row, column, and box. Select an empty cell and enter a number. Notes lets you record candidates.
